item.title: MOH’s Proposed RM3b Budget Cut Risks Worsening Health Care Crisis: Galen Centre
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Galen Centre for Health and Social Policy CEO Azrul Mohd Khalib warned a RM3.06b MOH budget cut would mean longer waits, shortages, staff burnout, and preventable deaths. He said the cut would not even match the RM4b spent monthly on RON95 and diesel subsidies. item.title: Report: Treasury Wants RM3b Cut To Health Ministry’s 2026 Budget
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
The Treasury has ordered budget cuts for various ministries this year due to a ballooning subsidy bill, specifying a proposed cut of about RM3 billion (6.6%) to the Health Ministry's RM46.5 billion 2026 budget, leaving MOH with a smaller budget than 2025. item.description:

item.title: Ascott Makes Full Switch To Cage-Free Eggs In Malaysia Amid Cost, Supply Concerns
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)

Stakeholders say it shows that large-scale adoption is feasible and could support wider industry uptake.
